newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio to make Benecol separate unit.
newsitem.headline: Raisio to make Benecol separate unit.

text.p: Finnish food, chemicals and animal feed group Raision Tehtaat Oy said on Wednesday it would make its Benecol cholesterol-reducing margarine business into a separate division to prepare for growth.

"Preparation for growth in the Benecol business is made by converting it into a separate business division in the group organisation as of June 1, 1997 alongside the foodstuffs division, the grain division and the chemicals division," Raisio said in a statement.
